name: Summit 2027
description: Sharp midnight-and-cyan site for a two-day design and engineering conference with a live countdown, speakers, schedule and tickets.
features: Live countdown to May 13, 2027 that pauses while the tab is hidden
Magnetic speaker cards that lean toward the mouse pointer
Accessible day 1 / day 2 schedule tabs with arrow-key, Home and End support
Three ticket tiers, tracks, venue map, FAQ and a team/partner enquiry form
signature: Live countdown to doors opening, magnetic speaker cards (mouse only) and keyboard-friendly day-1/day-2 schedule tabs
